newsitem.title: USA: Assets of money market funds rose in week.
newsitem.headline: Assets of money market funds rose in week.

text.p: Total money market mutual fund assets in the week ended July 9 rose to $986.65 billion from a revised $979.11 billion the prior week, an industry trade group said Thursday.
The Investment Company Institute said assets of the nation's 667 retail money market mutual funds rose $4.32 billion to $652.23 billion in the week.

Of the retail funds, assets of the 402 taxable money market funds rose $2.63 billion to $533.90 billion, while assets of the 265 tax-exempt funds increased $1.69 billion to $118.33 billion, the group said.

ICI said assets of the 325 institutional money market funds rose $3.22 billion to $334.42 billion. Of these, assets of the 262 taxable money market funds increased $3.09 billion to $298.17 billion, while assets of the 63 tax-exempt funds were up by $138.2 million to $36.25 billion, it said.
ICI revised total money market mutual fund assets for the previous week to $979.11 billion from $978.95 because of reporting errors and a change in the number of funds reporting.
